```sql
SELECT 
    CAST("Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST("Enrollment (K-12)" AS DOUBLE), 0) AS free_meal_rate
FROM main."frpm"
WHERE "County Name" = 'Alameda'
    AND "Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
LIMIT 1
```
